name: Silver and Golden Mark of War pay Runes of Ascension (#11849)
contract: Silver Mark of War 1201002 casts dummy spell 413116 ('Awards 250 Runes of Ascension.') and Golden Mark of War
1201003 casts dummy spell 413117 ('Awards 1000 Runes of Ascension.'). Both dropped from High-Risk rares and
Crow's Cache but had no script, so using them did nothing (#11849). Expected: using one Silver Mark from a stack
of two spends that mark and adds 250 Rune of Ascension (item 375250); using the Golden Mark spends it and brings
the total to 1250. The '4 Silver Marks upgrade into 1 Golden' line of the tooltip has no source and is not tested.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: one Silver Mark is spent
DISCRIMINATING: 250 runes reach the Currency tab
DISCRIMINATING: the Golden Mark is spent
